comment: I felt I was in over my head with readings but met with him every week to review homework assignments. He went out of his way to explain things and even e-mailed when I was sick to send links to assignments. I would major in LAIS if I could I learned so much!

The class was well thought out. I know people who thoroughly enjoyed this class, however I found professor Lima difficult to deal with. I thought he was egotistical and seemed to view his students as a "waste of his time." If you think that won't bother you then take his class and you will learn a lot.

He is a great teacher. Really willing to help and tries to get each of his students to really grasp the basics. He wants and expects the best out of each student so give it 100% or do not take him. You will be a waste of his time.
